name: OST-Bench v2 — Multi-round
protocol: OST-Bench v2 pinned multi-round zero-shot protocol and official leaderboard overall score. Interleaved and VLMEvalKit variants are excluded.

explanation.en: Option accuracy, exact match, and mean relative accuracy are aggregated into the official 0-100 multi-round overall score.
explanation.zh: option accuracy、exact match 和 mean relative accuracy 按官方规则汇总为 0–100 的 multi-round overall score。

summary.en: OST-Bench tests whether a multimodal model can update online spatial memory as first-person observations arrive without seeing future frames.
summary.zh: OST-Bench 测试多模态模型能否随着第一人称观察到达而更新在线空间记忆，同时不能偷看未来画面。

task_format.en: Each dialogue round appends four or five chronological egocentric frames, and the model answers a question about the scene state at that time.
task_format.zh: 每轮对话追加四到五张按时间排列的第一人称图像，模型需要回答该时刻场景状态相关的问题。
